title: Compute semi-harmonic correction S
action: Implement the semi-harmonic correction S for the parallel polarizability α∥ of H2 using the provided gas-phase expectation values, molecular constants, and perturbation coefficient K1. Compute the gas-phase finite-difference numerator (〈α∥(v=1)〉-〈α∥(v=0)〉) and denominator (〈R(v=1)〉-〈R(v=0)〉). Evaluate the matrix elements of the reduced coordinate ξ using harmonic oscillator functions for the relevant vibrational transitions. Calculate the correction S for the numerator (Eq. 7) and similarly S_R for the denominator (with b=1). Log all intermediate results.
description: Log file containing computed gas-phase numerator, denominator, S, and S_R values. Not directly scored; used for verification of intermediate steps.

title: Compute adsorbed finite-difference derivative of α∥
action: Compute the adsorbed-state finite-difference derivative of the parallel polarizability as (gas_numerator + S) / (gas_denominator + S_R) and write the resulting scalar to the output file. The calculation uses the intermediate values computed in the previous step.
description: A single floating-point number representing the adsorbed finite-difference derivative of α∥ in units of e²a₀²E_h⁻¹. This is the scored reproduction target.
